newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Group chosen to restructure Portugal pulp-paper.
newsitem.headline: Group chosen to restructure Portugal pulp-paper.

text.p: The Portuguese economy ministry has chosen a consortium comprising Banco Chemical and Salomon Brothers to prepare the restructuring of the pulp and paper sector, Diario Economico newspaper reported.
It said the government hoped the restructuring would be completed by the end of the year.
The restructuring aims to improve the integration between the pulp and paper sectors and boost Portuguese pulp exports, the paper said.
It said the government chose the consortium from 10 competing groups.
Portugal's main pulp companies are state-owned Portucel Industrial and Soporcel. Paper production is dominated by Inapa.
Economy ministry officials were not immediately available to comment on the newspaper report.
